messages:
vikram: Heads up — scheduling runtime v3.2.1 rollout for quant-v4b tonight at 23:00 UTC. Canary 5% for 30m via deploybot. We saw some tail instability on the staging canary (p99 spikes) so I want clear rollback/hold criteria before we go. :eyes:
sarah: Definitely. Can we list explicit rollback triggers? Need SLO impact and whether this will force a model pin if promoted then rolled back.
vikram: Proposed rollback triggers (short):
- error-rate >= 1% sustained for 5m
- p95 latency >= baseline * 1.5 for 5m
- any OOM or decoding failures / token-drop anomalies > 0.5% over 5m
If any hit, deploybot auto-rolls back to runtime v3.2.0 and notifies #incidents + oncall. Manual override by release leads only after ack from @sarah or me.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled: runtime-v3.2.1 -> prod @ 2023-11-12T23:00Z (canary 5% for 30m). Auto-rollback enabled with thresholds: err=0.01, p95_mult=1.5, token_drop=0.005. Canary check window 30m. Command used:
```
deploybot rollout --runtime v3.2.1 --canary 5 --watch 30m --auto-rollback
```
jen: nits — last time long-seq traffic caused KV-cache thrashing when we flipped the runtime. Recommend model-side soft-pin for variants that touch KV cache (quant-v4b -> quant-v4b-safe) during the canary window.
dana: +1 on soft-pin. Suggest we create a temporary override that maps requests with sequence > 2048 to fallback model for the first 2 hours post-promote (if promoted). That reduces blast radius.
ops-bot: ops-bot: set alerts: p95 > 300ms -> #incidents, error-rate > 0.8% -> pager to oncall, OOM detected -> immediate page. Telemetry dashboards: rollout/runtime/v3.2.1-canary.
sarah: SLA note: If we rollback after promotion, Dedicated customers may observe model/runtime mismatch for <30m while routing converges; we need a short release-note blurb + console banner. @maria can you draft the notice for console and changelog? :thumbsup:
maria: On it. I'll prepare a short changelog + rollback blurb and a console banner template. ETA 18:30 UTC. Will include a bullet on affected models and the soft-pin mapping.
vikram: Final decision: Proceed with 23:00 UTC schedule. Canary 5% for 30m. Ops to monitor dashboards; automatic rollback on thresholds above. If canary is clean, promote to 100% gradually over 2h with same monitoring. If trigger happens, deploybot will rollback automatically; manual rollbacks require approval from @sarah or @vikram. Marking for nightshift handoff — @jen please coordinate soft-pin mapping and @maria handles comms. Thanks all. :sparkles:
